{{quote|Kandor burns, and it rips my heart to know it, but we cannot stop that. Give Andor your greatest attention; it is too tactically important to ignore, and I would not see another land fall as mine has.|Antol, Prince of Kandor{{ref/book|14|7}}}}

'''Antol''' is the eldest son of Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] and [[Brys Noramaga]], "Prince Brys" of [[Kandor]]. He is the heir of the throne of Kandor.

== Appearance ==
Antol is tall, with a silent way about him.

==History==
He was born in {{ne|964}} and has been the heir to the [[Throne of the Clouds]] since birth. He is the eldest of eight siblings.{{ref/book|0|25}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu}}

He married a Kandori noblewoman.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Antol|comp}} His son is Prince [[Kaisel Noramaga]].{{ref/book|13|42}}

He is in southern Kandor with his mother when his father [[Brys]] and his brother [[Diryk]] are killed by the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|0|22}}

== Activities ==
He sends his son, Prince Kaisel, to join [[Lan Mandragoran]] in raising the Golden Crane.{{ref/book|13|42}}

Antol's mother Ethenielle leaves him in charge of the Kandori forces at the [[Field of Merrilor]], while she returns to Kandor, which has been lost to the [[Shadow]]. He signs the [[Dragon's Peace]] in her stead. Antol is in attendance at [[Elayne Trakand]]'s initial war-council, where it is decided that the army will fight on four fronts led by the four Great Generals. Antol and the rest of the Borderlander army will fight at [[Tarwin's Gap]]. He advised that forces should concentrate on the [[Andor]]an battlefront, as Kandor had already fallen. {{ref||comp}}{{ref/book|15|5}}
